breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a Biot number of 5 is invalid for the lumped-capacitance method. It resolved this inconsistency by changing the Biot number to a valid value of 0.05, which aligns with the correction made in the ground truth prompt. This allowed the requested calculation to be performed correctly.
